title: Reliable skin delivery - client 1.1.1
summary: Custom skins now use a new immutable client build with automatic AWS API fallback when the Cloudflare/R2 route fails.
notes: New eclipse-client-1.1.1 URL prevents stale CDN cache collisions.
CDN download retries safely, then switches to the API-hosted copy.
SHA-1/PNG verification and atomic disk cache prevent corrupted skins.
Launcher 1.0.7 supplies the production API URL before first render.
